messages:
Nadia: quick flag  noticed playbook cadence misfire for 'renewal-nudge' after enrichment job; lots of mid-market accounts got an extra nudge.
Ethan: saw a bump in outbound touches ~03:14 UTC. dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/outbound-touch-rate (filter: renewal-nudge)
Ravi: any idea why? was there a cadence change merged?
Nadia: no intentional cadence change. enrichment pipeline added a synthetic 'priority_score' field and playbook rule `if priority_score > 0.8 then cadence_multiplier=1.5` picked up unexpected values (0.9-1.2).
OpsBot: ALERT CREATED: PLAYBOOK_CADENCE_ANOMALY #3422100000 severity=high linked: enrichment-job-5543
Ethan: impact: ~420 extra nudges across 60 accounts, 9 accounts with renewals <30d.
Ravi: plan: 1) pause 'renewal-nudge' automation for source=enrichment 2) revert cadence multiplier rule 3) run dedupe/suppression for duplicates 4) notify AMs for 9 renewals.
Nadia: paused automation for enrichment-source: `playbook.pause(source=enrichment, rule=renewal-nudge)`  OpsBot confirmed.
OpsBot: command acknowledged: playbook.pause succeeded.
Ethan: creating list: `select account_id, count(*) as extra from outbound where rule='renewal-nudge' and created_at between '2025-08-04T03:10' and '2025-08-04T03:40' and extra>1` -> /tmp/extra_nudges_342210.csv
Ravi: reverted rule in staging and added a clamp: `priority_score = min(priority_score,1.0)` and unit test to CI. will push to prod after smoke tests.
Nadia: suppression dry-run shows 412 duplicates would be removed, leaving canonical touches intact. scheduling prod run in 20m.
AM_Liaison: DM template preview: "Heads-up: you may see one fewer automated renewal touch for <account>. We detected duplicate nudges due to a temporary scoring issue and suppressed duplicates. Reply if you want us to pause outreach entirely"
Ethan: prod suppression executed: suppressed=412, failures=0. owners for 9 renewals DM'd with links.
OpsBot: deploy note: clamp added, CI tests pass, prod deploy succeeded.
Ravi: follow-ups: add regression test on scoring distribution, alert if cadence_multiplier > 1.2, and require a canary window for enrichment-derived routing rules. I'll own these.
Nadia: filing short postmortem and will post to #customer-success-postmortems; tagging AMs. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
